final_draft.subject: Single-wide trailer, back row of the Duckville arena backdrop, derelict with rooftop TV antenna and satellite dish
final_draft.prompt: Early-90s arcade pixel art sprite in the style of WWF WrestleFest, Final Fight, Streets of Rage and Fatal Fury backgrounds. Late-afternoon golden-hour light from the low right: warm #FFD65A and #E19A36 highlights on the right-facing edges and roof, shadow sides in #17243A and #10151A, long shadow cast to the left across the ground, warm orange #D26938 bounce light.
